expectations.buyer: Enterprise treasury, procurement, legal, identity, security, and agent-platform teams authorizing AI-initiated transactions
expectations.pain: An enterprise cannot prove that an AI agent acts for the right legal entity, principal, role, purpose, amount, counterparty, and time window across systems
expectations.strongestIncumbent: IAM and workload identity, ERP approval matrices, corporate registers, e-signatures, delegated OAuth, verifiable credentials, payment-network mandates, and agent authorization protocols
expectations.biggestRisk: Existing identity and payment protocols may cover delegation primitives while corporate authority remains jurisdiction-specific, revocation-heavy, and controlled by enterprise systems of record
